ordered_gates.required: Frozen source/assets match; executor imports and interface probes pass without loading a GPU model; official scheduler/source paths are confirmed.
Prediction, share, subdeadline, snapshots, ordered frame membership, admission, preemption, routing, finish and KV accounting all meet STAGE2_FREEZE tolerances. Core-only agreement is insufficient.

B completes the official client warmup and main execution with all 14 calls, actual prediction/graph lifecycle, official SLOScheduler frames, real prompt tokens, coherent finish and KV accounting, and GPU0 release.
A and B run the same chain0 under the matched stage2 configuration in A→B order; independent metrics and material differences are reported.

stop_rule: Do not advance past any failed gate. In particular, a B integration that only reproduces GMAX priority/frame code cannot enter S2 or S3.

controlled_state_evidence.prediction_and_graph: Use identical public RequestInfo/prompt/history and controlled readiness timing; retain actual integer predictions, share and deadline calculations.
controlled_state_evidence.frames: Retain exact waiting/running order, ordered selected request IDs, schedule count, priority snapshots and official frame membership.
controlled_state_evidence.preemption_and_kv: Retain official block tables, queue transitions, swap-in/out maps, B token ledger and restoration witnesses.
controlled_state_evidence.finish: Retain token counts, stop reasons, sequence statuses, freed IDs and backend release events.

AB_not_algorithm_claim: A↔B measures native-backend/harness differences. It is not B↔C and cannot establish the frozen v2 mechanism advantage.
data_rule: Raw prompts, token IDs, detailed events and model/KV state stay on the server. Mac receives only lightweight metrics, acceptance and manifests.
